subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 4: Triangle Similarity: SSS and SAS
description: Use proportional side evidence to decide whether triangles are similar by SSS or SAS similarity.
learningObjectives: Identify corresponding sides and angles in two triangles
Test three pairs of sides for SSS similarity using equal ratios
Test two pairs of sides and the included angle for SAS similarity
Choose the correct similarity theorem from given evidence
Recognize non-examples when side ratios do not match or the angle is not included
Set up proportions to find missing side lengths in similar triangles
prerequisites: Recognize included angles between two given sides
Understand that similar figures have the same shape but may have different sizes
